children: Oil rises amid ongoing Middle East tensions that could exacerbate supply disruptions. "Conflict between Saudi Arabia and the Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen is threatening to escalate following the rebels' attacks on the airport in the Saudi capital," Commerzbank Research's Carsten Fritsch says in a research report. Also, transit through the Strait of Hormuz "carries the risk that Iran will attack ships, something that has been happening with increasing frequency recently," the commodity analyst adds. Front-month WTI crude oil futures are 0.9% higher at $94.98 per barrel; front-month Brent crude oil futures are 0.9% higher at $106.62 a barrel. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
